TUN.note: Nothing on AI harms rules or authority.

facts.fact: Tunisia's National Business Register (RNE) launched officially two AI chatbots called Nawwarni on its website, one guiding people creating a company and one for reserving company and trade names, per RNE director general Adel Chouari.

TUN.note: The chatbots serve business registration administration, not a named sector's public system.

facts.fact: The two Nawwarni chatbots were developed with two Tunisian start-ups, with support from the Hague Institute for Innovation of Law (HiiL), and launched on the RNE website, says RNE director general Adel Chouari.

TUN.note: Chatbots give guidance and name suggestions; no online registration, shared number or beneficial owners stated.
Chatbots were built with start-ups; no government staff running systems stated.
Start-ups named as developers only; no startup law, labelling or fund stated.
Chatbot coordinates with the tax directorate for information; no taxpayer register stated.
